headline: Optical Flow, Depth & Embodied Agents
summary: Focusing on optical flow and depth estimation, alongside perception, prediction, planning, and control for embodied agents. Exploring visual geometry and world models for robotic tasks.

focus.title: Optical Flow
focus.description: Studying pixel-level motion estimation in image sequences, including feature matching, iterative refinement, and robust estimation under occlusion and large displacements.

focus.title: Depth Estimation
focus.description: Studying monocular and stereo depth estimation, stereo matching, and 3D geometry, with attention to accuracy, generalization, and inference efficiency.

focus.title: Embodied Agents
focus.description: Studying embodied agents that combine visual perception, world models, and action generation for task planning, interaction, and closed-loop control.
